identity.name: Pioneer Centre Seconds
identity.one_liner: Moser's steel sports-adjacent dress watch, water resistant to 120 meters, built on the same fumé-dial language as the Endeavour line in a more robust, screw-crown case.

narrative.story: The Pioneer collection extended H. Moser's fumé-dial dress-watch language into a steel case built for daily wear, with a screw-down crown and 120 meters of water resistance well beyond the brand's typically dressier Endeavour and Venturer lines. The centre-seconds hand and automatic HMC 200 movement carry over from Moser's core catalog, so the shift from Endeavour to Pioneer is a case and use-case change rather than a movement change.
narrative.collector_notes: Dial color drives the collector market for Pioneer Centre Seconds far more than case finish; the Midnight Blue fumé of the original 3200-1200 remains the reference point buyers compare later colorways against.
